Opponent's Garchomp is at 27% HP with Life Orb. It's been chipped by Stealth Rock recoil... wait, no, Life Orb recoil. It's at 27/100.

Kingambit's stats: ATK 205, SPE 102. Garchomp's speed: base 102, at level 50... Garchomp base speed 102, so at level 50 with neutral nature, max speed would be around 132? Let me calculate: (102 + 31) * 2 * 50/100 + 5 = 133*2*0.5 + 5 = 133 + 5 = 138? Wait, formula: ((2*Base + IV + EV/4) * Level / 100) + 5. With max EVs and IVs, neutral nature: (2*102 + 31 + 63) * 50/100 + 5 = (204 + 94) * 0.5 + 5 = 298 * 0.5 + 5 = 149 + 5 = 154. Hmm, with a speed-boosting nature it'd be ~169.

Kingambit's speed is 102 listed. That's likely max speed neutral? Kingambit base 50 speed: (2*50+31+63)*0.5+5 = 194*0.5+5 = 97+5 = 102. So Kingambit is 102 speed, Garchomp could be up to 154+ speed. Garchomp is almost certainly faster than Kingambit.

So Garchomp moves first. Garchomp at 27% HP with Life Orb. What can it do? Earthquake vs Kingambit: Kingambit is Dark/Steel, Ground hits Steel neutrally... wait, Ground is neutral vs Steel, and Dark is neutral to Ground. So Earthquake is neutral on Kingambit. Kingambit has 140 DEF, 175 HP. Earthquake from Garchomp (base 130 ATK, Life Orb) - neutral damage, Kingambit is physically bulky. It won't KO Kingambit from full.

Kingambit's options:
1. Kowtow Cleave (Dark, 85 BP): vs Garchomp (Dragon/Ground), Dark is neutral. Damage: 85 BP, STAB 1.5, Supreme Overlord 1.2, vs 27% HP Garchomp. Garchomp has 95 base DEF. Kingambit 205 ATK. This should easily KO from 27%.

2. Sucker Punch (Dark, 70 BP, priority): Works only if opponent attacks. Garchomp will likely attack with Earthquake. Sucker Punch at 70 BP with STAB and Supreme Overlord boost. Also should KO from 27%.

3. Iron Head (Steel, 80 BP): Neutral vs Garchomp.

4. Swords Dance: Set up.

Wait, but there's a risk: Garchomp could use Stealth Rock or something else. But at 27% HP, it will likely attack.

Actually, let me think about whether Kowtow Cleave KOs. Garchomp at 27% HP (roughly 29/108... wait, level 50 Garchomp HP: base 108, so (2*108+31+63)*0.5+110/... HP formula: ((2*Base + IV + EV/4) * Level/100) + Level + 10 = (2*108+31+63)*0.5 + 50 + 10 = 310*0.5 + 60 = 155+60 = 215. So 27% of 215 ≈ 58 HP.

Kowtow Cleave: 85 BP * 1.5 STAB * 1.2 Supreme Overlord = 153 effective BP. Kingambit 205 ATK vs Garchomp DEF: base 95, so (2*95+31+63)*0.5+5 = 284*0.5+5 = 142+5 = 147.

Damage = ((2*50/5 + 2) * 85 * 205/147)/50 + 2 = ((22) * 85 * 1.394)/50 + 2 = (22*85 = 1870; 1870*1.394 ≈ 2607)/50 + 2 = 52.1 + 2 = 54.1, then * 1.5 (STAB) * 1.2 (Supreme Overlord)... wait I need to redo.

(2*50/5 + 2) = 22.
Power = 85.
A/D = 205/147 ≈ 1.394.
Base damage = (22 * 85 * 1.394)/50 + 2 = 2607/50 + 2 = 52.1 + 2 = 54.1.
Modifiers: STAB 1.5, Supreme Overlord 1.2 (2 fallen allies = 20%), random 0.85-1.0.
54.1 * 1.5 * 1.2 = 97.4. Min roll 0.85: 82.8.

Garchomp has ~58 HP. So Kowtow Cleave definitely KOs (min 82 > 58).

Sucker Punch: 70 BP: 54.1 * (70/85) = 44.5 base, * 1.5 * 1.2 = 80.1, min 68. Also KOs.

But Sucker Punch fails if Garchomp doesn't attack. Garchomp at 27% might... it's the AI/opponent. It could switch? Actually the opponent has 1 more Pokémon to come in. Garchomp could switch out to preserve it? Hmm, but typically at 27% it would attack.

Kowtow Cleave is the safer option - guaranteed to work regardless of what Garchomp does. If Garchomp switches, Kowtow Cleave still hits the incoming Pokémon (Dark is neutral vs most). Sucker Punch would fail against a switch or status move.

Actually wait - is there any concern about Garchomp outspeeding and KOing Kingambit first? Earthquake is neutral vs Kingambit, Kingambit is very physically bulky (140 DEF, 175 HP). Garchomp's Earthquake: base 130 ATK with Life Orb, (2*130+31+63)*0.5+5 = 354*0.5+5 = 177+5 = 182 ATK. vs Kingambit DEF 140: (2*140+31+63)*0.5+5 = 374*0.5+5 = 187+5 = 192.

Damage = (22 * 100 * 182/192)/50 + 2 = (22*100=2200; 2200*0.948=2085.6)/50 + 2 = 41.7 + 2 = 43.7. * 1.5 (Life Orb) = 65.5. Kingambit has 175 HP. So Earthquake does ~37% max. Kingambit survives easily.

So the safest play: Kowtow Cleave to KO Garchomp. Guaranteed KO regardless of Garchomp's action (unless it protects, but it doesn't have protect revealed).

Actually, should I consider Swords Dance? If Garchomp stays in and attacks, I take ~37% and then KO with Kowtow. But why take damage? Kowtow Cleave KOs now. Garchomp is faster, but its attack won't KO me. Still, no reason to SD when I can just KO.

One consideration: Sucker Punch vs Kowtow Cleave. Sucker Punch has priority, so even if Garchomp somehow outspeeds and I'm worried about... no, Earthquake can't KO me. Kowtow Cleave is strictly better here since it works even if Garchomp switches or uses a status move. Both KO. Kowtow Cleave it is.
